title.purpose: The page's title, once; 30 px on a phone.

heading.purpose: H1–H4 inside the page, in em so they scale with the body.

body.purpose: The page's words — the largest text on any screen; follows Dynamic Type on iOS.

label.purpose: Section titles, chips, timestamps, in Ink Muted.

mono.purpose: Code, coloured by the syntax tokens.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Anything that floats over the page; the only shadow.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Everything that appears or reacts (200 ms in, 150 ms out).

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: The few things that move from place to place.

motion.name: loop
motion.purpose: The one loop: the AI-at-work shimmer; a spinner under Reduce Motion.

breakpoints.name: phone-column
breakpoints.purpose: Below it the title is 30 px and the page margins 24 px.

breakpoints.name: home-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Home becomes a list instead of a table.

breakpoints.name: comments-margin
breakpoints.purpose: Comment cards move into the right margin.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one seal on a screen: Send, Save, the phone's pencil.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #cb1b45; color: #fff; font: 500 13px/1.4 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 6px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b8183e; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(28,28,28,0.3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button / Menu Row
components.description: Rows in menus, lists and panels; hover is the wash, press 97 %.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: 31px; padding: 0 8px; background: transparent; color: #37352f; font: 400 13px/1.4 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; text-align: left; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-row:hover { background: rgba(55,53,47,0.06); } .ds-row:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-row-icon { display: inline-flex; color: rgba(55,53,47,0.65); }

components.name: Field
components.description: A text field: paper, a field line, an ink ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 6px 10px; background: #fff; color: #37352f; font: 400 13px/1.4 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid rgba(55,53,47,0.16); border-radius: 6px; outline: none; transition: box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-field::placeholder { color: rgba(55,53,47,0.3); } .ds-field:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(28,28,28,0.3); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: A filter or context chip; selected is the stronger wash.

components.description: A link preview or embed in the page: hairline, 12 px corners, no shadow.

narrative.overview: Hikki looks like a quiet desk someone studies at: white paper, one warm ink, and a single red seal. Everything a person wrote sits on the paper in a system face set generously; everything the app says around it is smaller, quieter and drawn from the same ink at a lower strength. The seal, Kurenai, is the only chromatic voice: it marks the one thing on a screen and nothing else. The density is Notion's; the materials are the platform's, so brand lives in the ink, the seal and the typography, not in chrome.
keyCharacteristics: One ink at many strengths; one seal, used once per screen.
The platform's own chrome, our tokens inside it; the same tokens on both renderers.
Reading first: the page's words are the largest, most contrasted thing on any screen.
Quiet motion from one pair of curves; nothing loops but the AI-at-work shimmer.

rules.name: The One Seal Rule
rules.body: Kurenai marks at most one thing per screen, and that thing is an action or a state — never decoration, never a heading, never an illustration.

rules.name: The Ink Wash Rule
rules.body: Every grey is the ink at an alpha. There is no second grey.

rules.name: The Reading Rule
rules.body: On any screen the page's words are the largest, highest-contrast text; the app's words never compete. Nothing in the UI goes above 20 px except a title.

rules.name: The Scaled Rule
rules.body: On iOS every native size scales with the system text size, and the page's words with it; a fixed point size is a bug.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; a shadow means "this floats and will go away".

dos: Do take every colour, size, radius and duration from design/tokens.json; make lint-design refuses literals.
Do mark exactly one thing per screen with Kurenai, and make it an action or a state.
Do build greys as the ink at an alpha (6 / 8 / 9 / 10 / 16 / 30 / 45 / 65 %) — pick the strength, not a hue.
Do use the platform's component for anything the platform has and the shadcn component on the web; never a bare <button> or <input>.
Do move everything with the one pair of curves (ease-out 200 ms in, 150 ms out); loop only the AI shimmer, and honour Reduce Motion.
Do draw icons from one list: SF Symbols natively and inside the page on iOS, Phosphor on the Mac's page — one weight, baseline-aligned.
Do keep the page's words at 16 px / 1.5 on a 708 px column and let them scale with the reader's text size.
donts: Don't add gradients, gradient text, coloured glows, glass as decoration, or a second accent.
Don't put a shadow on anything that doesn't float, or a coloured left border on cards, callouts or alerts.
Don't introduce a grey that isn't the ink, a radius that isn't on the scale, or a duration of its own.
Don't let UI text grow past 20 px, or use the title size anywhere but the page's title.
Don't decorate with emoji or Unicode glyphs where an icon belongs.
Don't reintroduce a custom title bar or custom navigation; the window chrome is the system's.
